Ktas.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. The unresolved Northern Dial credit maps to K-Tas on DK's 'Circa 91' from Atlantic Rap Vol. 1. Apple Music/Qobuz identify K-Tas as songwriter Demiko Preston Rodriguez Jr., and the K-TAS U.S. trademark filing for that same name lists the owner in Monticello, New York, United States. A.P. Da Overlord also describes K-Tas as his lifelong friend and discusses reconnecting with him in New York. This is the matching U.S. rapper, not a Canadian artist.
